requirements.title: Explicit practical workflow preserves honest check and migration boundaries

statement.text: A schema-5 opt-in contract runs canonical checks once at the selected boundary without legacy evidence transport, can bind CI to an exact revision, reports selected manual procedures as unrun rather than fabricated command failures, rejects unsafe or stale migration, and never treats setup or saved review as product verification.

requirements.rationale: Reduce process cost while retaining explicit policy choice, current executions and safe migration; stronger external obligations remain additive.

criteria.expected: Executable tests distinguish command deduplication and real failures, exact CI revision and stage selection, nonqualifying manual procedures, stage-independent links, explicit presets, strict namespace and stale-safe migration from approval, complete adoption and remote qualification claims.
